title: CommandPalette
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet (fully expanded) holding MonarchSearchBar (androidx.compose.material3.DockedSearchBar) and MonarchSearchResults (a androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn), opened by a button and by androidx.compose.ui.input.key.onPreviewKeyEvent for Ctrl+K
summary: A recipe, not a component: a full-height search sheet whose results are commands and places, grouped, run by tapping one; Ctrl+K opens it on a hardware keyboard.
whenToUse: For apps with many commands or places, so people can type what they want instead of hunting through menus.
whenNotToUse: For searching records only, use MonarchSearchBar with MonarchSearchResults on the screen. For a few actions, use a MonarchMenu (menu-button recipe).
api: Modifier.onPreviewKeyEvent { event -> event.type == KeyEventType.KeyDown && event.isCtrlPressed && event.key == Key.K }
MonarchSearchBar(query = query, onQueryChange = { query = it }, onSearch = {}, placeholder = "Type a command or search")
MonarchSearchResults(groups = commands grouped by heading, onSelect = { result, _ -> run it and close }, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), query = query)

options.name: commands
options.type: List of id, label and group
options.description: The commands and places, each under a group heading such as Actions or Go to; filter them by the query.

options.name: open
options.description: Whether the sheet is shown, kept with rememberSaveable.

options.name: query
options.description: The search text; cleared when the sheet closes.

options.name: sources
options.description: Results fetched as the person types: run them in a LaunchedEffect keyed on the query, pass loading to MonarchSearchResults and cancel with the effect.

states.name: closed
states.description: Only the trigger button (or a search MonarchIconButton in the top app bar) is shown.

states.name: open
states.description: The sheet fills the screen with the search field at the top and grouped results under it.

states.name: no results
states.description: MonarchSearchResults shows its empty state for the query.

states.name: loading
states.description: Pass loading to MonarchSearchResults while server results arrive.

appearance: A Material 3 bottom sheet in the Monarch theme holding the docked search bar and grouped result rows. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web ships CommandPalette as a centered dialog with keyboard navigation, nested pages, recent items, shortcut hints and async sources. On a phone the native pattern is a full-height sheet with a search field, so the recipe uses MonarchBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and MonarchSearchResults; touch replaces arrow keys and TalkBack moves through the results in order. The Ctrl+K shortcut applies to hardware keyboards only; put onPreviewKeyEvent on the screen's root so it works wherever focus is. Shortcut hints are left out because touch users have no keys; nested pages become a second query state or a second sheet; recent items are a Recent group while the query is empty. The system back gesture closes the sheet.
accessibility: The trigger is a button with a 48dp target.
The sheet is a modal pane; back and the scrim close it.
The search field has the search role from Material 3.
Group headings are headings and each result is one button, from MonarchSearchResults, which also announces the result count.
Closing after a command returns focus to the screen.
edgeCases: Never put MonarchSearchResults inside verticalScroll; give it the remaining height with weight(1f).
Clear the query when the sheet closes so the next opening starts fresh.
A command that needs confirmation should close the sheet and open a dialog.
